If we already know all funds are being withdrawn, we won't have to check again here in this function.  If withdrawing all funds, we choose _withdrawFromPool or _withdrawAllFromPool based on estimated gas usage. The value of `all` is trusted because `msg.sender` is always RariFundManager.
